categorias.titulo: Crash (script, gate or test: rc != 0, exception, timeout)
Quota, network, API and model session
Git and worktree (conflict, wrong branch, dirty or orphan)
Windows (atomic rename, CRLF, paths, console close)

edge_cases.gatilho: Ctrl+C during a michi phase (DA step half done)
edge_cases.esperado: the last finished phase and step are journaled; `kaizen resume` continues from the next step

edge_cases.gatilho: Pane of a queued story closed while it was running
edge_cases.esperado: the watcher marks the story `falhou` and frees the slot; the next story in the queue starts

edge_cases.gatilho: Ctrl+C while `sp-gates.py` is running a gate
edge_cases.esperado: the unfinished gate is not cached as green; rerunning the gates starts that gate again

edge_cases.gatilho: Interrupted while a story file is being rewritten (move, handoff, approval)
edge_cases.esperado: the write is atomic: the story is either the old or the new version, never truncated

edge_cases.gatilho: Fresh session fails while printing the handoff it is consuming
edge_cases.esperado: the handoff file is kept; `handoff.py consume` can be run again

edge_cases.gatilho: Ctrl+D (EOF) at a terminal confirmation
edge_cases.esperado: EOF counts as no; nothing is abandoned or deleted

edge_cases.gatilho: A gate exits with rc != 0
edge_cases.esperado: gates stop at the first red one and the table marks the rest as not run

edge_cases.gatilho: A gate hangs
edge_cases.esperado: the gate times out and counts as red with the timeout shown

edge_cases.gatilho: The test phase command hangs
edge_cases.esperado: timeout recorded as a failed attempt in the story

edge_cases.gatilho: An `sp-*` script raises an unexpected exception
edge_cases.esperado: the failure is appended to the local error log with script and type; rc != 0

edge_cases.gatilho: The error log cannot be written (read-only or missing folder)
edge_cases.esperado: logging fails silently and the script keeps its own rc

edge_cases.gatilho: A blocking workflow hook times out
edge_cases.esperado: the action is aborted before it changes anything

edge_cases.gatilho: Unexpected error while the watcher handles one story
edge_cases.esperado: the other stories of the queue are still handled

edge_cases.gatilho: The same gate keeps failing
edge_cases.esperado: after `max_tentativas` the run stops and asks instead of looping

edge_cases.gatilho: A script module fails while being imported by another
edge_cases.esperado: the half-loaded module is not left registered; the next import retries cleanly

edge_cases.gatilho: Model quota or rate limit hit mid-phase
edge_cases.esperado: the story is left `bloqueado` with the cause; `kaizen resume` continues once the quota is back

edge_cases.gatilho: Network down during push or PR creation
edge_cases.esperado: the step is recorded as pending with the command to retry; nothing is marked done

edge_cases.gatilho: A PR check errors on the hosting API
edge_cases.esperado: the check name and URL are shown

edge_cases.gatilho: Model session or context runs out mid-phase
edge_cases.esperado: the phase is journaled before the handoff; the fresh session resumes from it

edge_cases.gatilho: A session ends before done and the story allows escalation
edge_cases.esperado: the story is relaunched once at the next model level, in the same slot

edge_cases.gatilho: The Enter sent to a new pane is lost and the prompt is not submitted
edge_cases.esperado: Enter is resent a bounded number of times, then the launch is marked as error

edge_cases.gatilho: Author pane launched but the prompt never submits (`falhou`) after the ephemeral seed was deleted
edge_cases.esperado: the seed is kept until the session has read it, so the launch can be retried

edge_cases.gatilho: PR merge hits a conflict
edge_cases.esperado: rc 12 and no merge; the conflict is reported

edge_cases.gatilho: Watcher about to merge a story with red gates or a conflict
edge_cases.esperado: the story is blocked with the reason; no merge

edge_cases.gatilho: Story branch is behind the main branch
edge_cases.esperado: `sp-estado.py` warns and says to merge the main branch first

edge_cases.gatilho: Worktree to clean is still in use by a process
edge_cases.esperado: the clean is retried instead of leaving a half-removed worktree

edge_cases.gatilho: Story left in Doing with no live pane (orphan)
edge_cases.esperado: it is listed as a resume candidate

edge_cases.gatilho: Cleanup finds a dirty worktree
edge_cases.esperado: the worktree and its pane are never closed

edge_cases.gatilho: Leftover files in a finished worktree include a secret
edge_cases.esperado: the watcher refuses to commit them

edge_cases.gatilho: A stale copy of the story is left in TODO after it is closed
edge_cases.esperado: closing removes the copy

edge_cases.gatilho: Agent starts writing while the main checkout is not on the main branch
edge_cases.esperado: a preflight refuses and prints the command that fixes it

edge_cases.gatilho: Terminal crashed or machine off with panes still registered `a-correr`
edge_cases.esperado: registrations are reconciled with the live panes so orphans no longer take a slot

edge_cases.gatilho: Story left `pendente` for lack of a slot when a slot opens
edge_cases.esperado: the pending story starts on its own

edge_cases.gatilho: Session closed before the story reaches done
edge_cases.esperado: the story becomes `falhou` and the queue launches the next one

edge_cases.gatilho: The terminal GUI socket recorded for handoff is dead
edge_cases.esperado: the most recent live socket is used

edge_cases.gatilho: No terminal multiplexer available for a parallel queue
edge_cases.esperado: refused with a clear error before any state is created

edge_cases.gatilho: Multiplexer times out when listing panes
edge_cases.esperado: a warning, and the list is shown with liveness unknown

edge_cases.gatilho: Queue state left by a run that died (reboot)
edge_cases.esperado: the stale queue is archived in `obsoletas/` and a new one starts

edge_cases.gatilho: Watcher pid file left behind by a crash
edge_cases.esperado: stopping with a dead pid only deletes the file

edge_cases.gatilho: Two writers update the queue state at the same time
edge_cases.esperado: no record is lost

edge_cases.gatilho: Lock file held by a dead process
edge_cases.esperado: the lock is recovered

edge_cases.gatilho: Lock file held by a live process
edge_cases.esperado: the lock is never stolen

edge_cases.gatilho: Two panes or agents start the same story
edge_cases.esperado: the second claim is refused

edge_cases.gatilho: Two queues want the merge lock
edge_cases.esperado: one merges, the other waits for the next tick

edge_cases.gatilho: Queue state JSON is corrupted
edge_cases.esperado: clear error and the file is not deleted

edge_cases.gatilho: Workflow hooks config is corrupted
edge_cases.esperado: the config is ignored and the action goes on

edge_cases.gatilho: Pane state file is corrupted or its folder is missing
edge_cases.esperado: the pane hook never crashes the session

edge_cases.gatilho: `--seguinte` arrives while a story is still being launched
edge_cases.esperado: the same story is not launched twice

edge_cases.gatilho: A second watcher is started for the same queue
edge_cases.esperado: it is refused

edge_cases.gatilho: Phase journal missing or corrupted at resume
edge_cases.esperado: resume falls back to the last valid entry and says which one

edge_cases.gatilho: `os.replace` fails with PermissionError (antivirus or indexer lock)
edge_cases.esperado: the rename is retried

edge_cases.gatilho: Story file with CRLF line endings is rewritten by a handoff
edge_cases.esperado: CRLF is preserved

edge_cases.gatilho: Story file with CRLF line endings is approved
edge_cases.esperado: CRLF is preserved and approving twice changes nothing

edge_cases.gatilho: Resume command sent to a pane with spaces in the path
edge_cases.esperado: the path reaches the pane intact

edge_cases.gatilho: Worktree path longer than 260 characters
edge_cases.esperado: a clear error naming the path, or long-path support, never a half-created worktree

edge_cases.gatilho: Accented characters in a path or story title
edge_cases.esperado: files are read and written as UTF-8 without mangling

edge_cases.gatilho: Console window closed (CTRL_CLOSE_EVENT) during a phase
edge_cases.esperado: the phase journal is flushed before the process ends

edge_cases.gatilho: Text with control characters sent to a pane
edge_cases.esperado: it is refused before anything is sent

edge_cases.gatilho: `/sp-handoff --launch` run inside a pane started by a queue (`/clear`, then `/michi` in the same pane)
edge_cases.esperado: the handoff is allowed; the watcher keeps the story `a-correr` and does not mark it `falhou` or launch the next one

edge_cases.gatilho: Story worktree has uncommitted changes when a run starts
edge_cases.esperado: the preflight lists the dirty files with EC-060 and proposes `git stash push -u -m <tag>`; nothing is changed without `--fix` and confirmation

edge_cases.gatilho: Worktree is on a branch that is not `agent/<slug>` (or the story's branch)
edge_cases.esperado: the preflight reports the current and expected branch with EC-061 and proposes `git checkout <branch>`

edge_cases.gatilho: The story's worktree is missing
edge_cases.esperado: the preflight reports EC-062 and proposes the command that creates it; no state is touched

edge_cases.gatilho: A worktree is registered but its folder is gone (prunable)
edge_cases.esperado: the preflight reports EC-063 and proposes `git worktree prune`; never `worktree remove --force`

edge_cases.gatilho: A merge, rebase or cherry-pick is half done in the worktree
edge_cases.esperado: the preflight reports EC-064 and suggests `--continue`/`--abort` without running them

edge_cases.gatilho: `git` or Python is not on PATH
edge_cases.esperado: the preflight reports EC-065 with what is missing and how to install it; rc 1

edge_cases.gatilho: Model login or session expired (`/login`, OAuth token expired)
edge_cases.esperado: the story is left `bloqueado` with the cause and no automatic resume time; the message says to log in and run `kaizen resume`

edge_cases.gatilho: Invalid request to a kaizen command or to the queue state (unknown slug or folder, invalid transition or phase, wrong option)
edge_cases.esperado: refused without writing; the message (EC format) says what is valid and the next command

edge_cases.gatilho: Kaizen pieces missing from a project (skills, scripts, AGENTS.md block, hooks)
edge_cases.esperado: `kaizen doctor` reports them in one EC-068 message with rc 1 and proposes `kaizen doctor --fix`; nothing is overwritten
edge_cases.teste: tests/cli-hardening.test.js::doctor com peças em falta lista-as numa mensagem EC-068 e propõe --fix

edge_cases.gatilho: Terminal pane closed (SIGHUP) during a phase on Linux or macOS
edge_cases.esperado: the checkpoint is written with `interrompido: true` before the process ends (rc 128+SIGHUP)

edge_cases.gatilho: A queue pane reports `bloqueado` because of context (`[context-guard]`)
edge_cases.esperado: the watcher runs the handoff in the same pane and puts the story back to `a-correr`; the pane, the slot and the lock are kept

edge_cases.gatilho: A queue pane is blocked asking for an authorization the story already covers (`restricoes`/`permitir`/`## Decisões`)
edge_cases.esperado: the watcher sends the confirmation to the pane, logs it in `vigia.log` and `## Report modo auto`, and sets `a-correr`

edge_cases.gatilho: A blocked pane asks for something the story does not cover, or for an irreversible action (`--force`, `reset --hard`, publish/tag, secrets)
edge_cases.esperado: the watcher never answers: it warns once and the story stays `bloqueado`

edge_cases.gatilho: The same story is blocked a third time after two automatic reactions
edge_cases.esperado: the watcher stops reacting and escalates to the user

edge_cases.gatilho: Two panes are launched for the same slug
edge_cases.esperado: the second gets the next free name (`-2`, `-3`), never the first one's

edge_cases.gatilho: A named pane is gone (closed or machine restarted) while its name is still registered
edge_cases.esperado: the name is pruned on the next read and no longer resolves; reopening the same slug gets the same name back

edge_cases.gatilho: `orq` is asked to close the `kaizen` pane (by name or by id)
edge_cases.esperado: it is refused with a clear error (rc 2) and nothing is closed

edge_cases.gatilho: A pane is registered with an invalid name (uppercase, spaces, over 48 characters)
edge_cases.esperado: the registration is refused and the registry is left untouched

edge_cases.gatilho: The name registry file is corrupted
edge_cases.esperado: it is recreated empty with a warning; panes keep working by id

edge_cases.gatilho: A `VISION.md` still holds `TBD`/`TODO`/`(preencher)` placeholders (e.g. straight from `kaizen vision init`)
edge_cases.esperado: `kaizen vision validate` exits 1 and lists every unfilled field and section; nothing downstream consumes it

edge_cases.gatilho: A `VISION.md` saved on Windows with a UTF-8 BOM, CRLF line endings and accented text
edge_cases.esperado: it is read and validated like any other file, without mangling the accents

edge_cases.gatilho: An advisory (`consultivos`) quality gate fails
edge_cases.esperado: it is reported as `consultivo aviso`, the run goes on and `sp-gates` still exits 0

edge_cases.gatilho: A repo has no `qualidade` profile (or only `coberturaDiff`), or an SP lists a profile command already in its own `gates:`
edge_cases.esperado: old behaviour is kept; the duplicate runs once, as the SP's blocking gate
